responsibility: This header defines the NDS32 backend’s core option-related enums and defaults shared by generated option tables and target code. It names architecture, CPU, code-model, ICT-model, multiply-configuration, register-port, ABI, and FPU-register-count enumerations, plus a few default constants such as cache block and ISR vector sizes, making it the common type layer consumed by nds32.opt, Linux/ELF option fragments, and backend implementation code.
